channel.title: Angola - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Angola, every source cited.

item.title: Angolan NGOs demand electoral probe
item.description: Three civil society groups asked prosecutors to investigate alleged failures in the voter registration process.

item.title: Kiluanji Kia Henda film premieres at Rotterdam festival
item.description: The Angolan artist's new film, "Karl Marx, Luanda," combines African science fiction with spaghetti westerns.

item.title: Angola uses penal code against journalists
item.description: The constitution guarantees free expression, but courts prosecute reporters for defamation.
